title: Tuliprox plugin marketplace catalog (format_version 1)
description: The marketplace.json a repository publishes. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored. There is no hash, checksum or signature field by design.

id.description: The plugin id; unique in the catalog.

category.description: What kind of plugin it is. Normalised by the host: lower case, every run of spaces, underscores and other separators one `-` (`Live TV` is `live-tv`), and a value that leaves no valid id (2 to 32 characters, starting with a letter) counts as none. The ids the Web UI names: notifier, playlist, epg, metadata, input, output, stream, automation, monitoring.

package_url.description: Direct URL of the .tlpx package. https only.

min_tuliprox_version.description: Lowest Tuliprox version the release runs on. Absent means any.

plugin_api.description: The plugin API (ABI) major the package is built for.

capabilities.description: Informational. The admin approves the capabilities of the downloaded package, not these.
